exposure: trial of labor after one cesarean delivery
outcome: Cesarean delivery after onset of labor
cohort: 339 women with a trial of labor after one prior cesarean and a singleton term fetus in cephalic presentation
finding: Labor induction after one prior cesarean was associated with a higher risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, including a composite outcome of uterine rupture, low Apgar score, neonatal resuscitation, or admission to a neonatal unit, as well as cesarean delivery after onset of labor and longer maternal hospital stay.
mod_finding: Labor induction after one prior cesarean was associated with a higher risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, including a higher proportion of uterine rupture.
